notes:
Context: Lodestar manages regional water treatment and emergency response for three states. Very conservative security posture; anything that touches control-plane must be customer-managed and air-gapped.

Key decision makers: CTO (Marina Delgado), Head of IT Ops (Colin Reeves), Chief Security Officer (Daphne Lang). Procurement leads are on a May funding cadence.

Requirements summary (from calls):
- Must deploy fully on-prem inside SCIF-like zone with no internet egress; appliance or container bundle to be delivered on-site.
- KMS/HSM integration mandatory; customer will supply HSM / key material and Redwood must support bring-your-own-keys model.
- Audit logs retained for 7+ years; immutable logs required for incident forensics.
- SSO via SAML required for mgmt plane; RBAC for models/routes.
- Model residency: all model weights remain behind their firewall; Redwood must support model packaging and local runtime only.
- Latency targets: <= 200ms p50 for chat operations in normal ops; throughput modest (50-200 concurrent sessions).
- Cost sensitivity: total cost of ownership prioritized over per-token pricing; prefer fixed reserved pricing for Dedicated/Private.

Notes from Marina (CTO): "We will never allow outbound model downloads from our network. If you cannot run entirely inside our air-gapped environment, we cannot proceed."

SE notes (Ravi): POC plan includes: deliverable appliance image + orchestration playbook, integration test harness (simulated ops traffic), sample audit log format, HSM key wrap demo. Need facilities window to stage hardware.

Procurement red flags: standard Redwood SaaS terms will not fly; need enterprise addendum for on-prem deployment, liability carveouts for offline install, and on-site support SLA add-on.

- Ravi to prepare HSM integration demo by 2026-03-22.
- Elena to draft CSM onboarding plan for air-gapped customers (template).
